mapper.select: SELECT MF13.MF13_COMPANY /*회사*/ ,MF13.MF13_FACTORY /*공장*/ ,MF13.MF13_NO /*출고요청번호*/ ,MF13.MF13_DAT /*출고요청일자*/ ,MF13.MF13_SEQ /*순번*/ ,TO_CHAR(MF13.MF13_INDTE,'AM HH24:MI') AS MF13_INDTE /*등록일자*/ ,MF13.MF13_EMPNO /*등록자사번*/ ,ST03.ST03_NO /*출고번호*/ ,TO_CHAR(ST03.ST03_DAT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ST03_DAT /*출고일자*/ ,ST03.ST03_INDTE /*출고시간*/ ,ST03.ST03_SEQ /*출고순번*/ FROM TB_MF_13 MF13 /*출고요청서 마스터*/ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ST03.ST03_OUTPUT_NO ORDER BY ST03.ST03_OUTPUT_NO, ST03.ST03_SEQ) RNUM,ST03.* FROM TB_ST_03 ST03 ) ST03 WHERE ST03.RNUM = 1 ) ST03 ON MF13.MF13_COMPANY = ST03.ST03_COMPANY AND MF13.MF13_FACTORY = ST03.ST03_FACTORY AND MF13.MF13_NO = ST03.ST03_OUTPUT_NO ORDER BY MF13.MF13_INDTE DESC
